data.narrative:
INERATEC is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $129M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (Linzagolix: LNZA) in the same sector and stage band, including three direct peers: KoBold Metals ($3.0B Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B Series C), and Amogy ($700M Series C).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $129M raised proxy, yielding $245M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The stage difference—INERATEC is Series B while the peer median is Series C—explains the divergence between methods; the peer set likely reflects later-stage risk reduction and market validation not yet present in INERATEC's profile.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $208M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $623M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around both INERATEC's technology maturation relative to later-stage peers and the nascent comparables market in frontier climate tech. Key sensitivities include capital efficiency relative to peers, nearness to commercialization, and sector momentum in deployment-stage funding. The median of $623M reflects a conservative position between stage-adjusted and peer-adjusted estimates.
